# PR template

## What

Short description.

## Why

Problem addressed.

## How

Files touched, approach (especially `clipper.js` rule changes).

## Manual test checklist

- [ ] Article clip on a real article
- [ ] Selection clip
- [ ] Photo Lab grab on a page with 50+ images (dedupe + filters)
- [ ] Screenshot embed + download
- [ ] Library search + export `.md` + backup/restore
- [ ] Dark/light toggle
- [ ] Context menus + at least one keyboard command
- [ ] `manifest.json` version bumped (user-facing)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated

## Screenshots

Before/after for UI changes.
